'''Juilaine Madome''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] and for a while a loyalist [[Sitter]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].

== Appearance and Personality ==
She is attractive with short-cut black hair and dark eyes. She is 5'7" (170&nbsp;cm) tall. 

==Strength and Abilities==
Juilaine has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|27}}, [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

== History ==
Juilaine was born in {{ne|903}}. She was born with the [[spark]] and was a tomboy when she was found, climbing trees, running in the streets and wearing boy's clothes much more often than dresses. 

She is a lesbian. She would wear a dress if needed to attract another woman.

She went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|919}} at the age of sixteen. 

After thirteen years as [[novice]] and five as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the [[shawl]] in the year {{ne|937}}. 

She has worn the shawl for less than seventy years and she is one of the [[Too Young Sitters]].

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.{{Ref/book|8|26}}

She was hand-picked by her [[Ajah Head]], [[Jesse Bilal]], as a Sitter in the [[Hall of the Tower]] - not the usual way of raising Sitters for the Brown.{{Ref/book|8|25}} Juilaine was not the natural choice for a new Sitter because she was too young. She is part of the trend of Sitters being too young for the position.{{Ref/book|10|p}}

She snubs [[Seaine Herimon]], another Sitter, in the corridors of the [[White Tower]], a clear sign of the rampant rivalry among the [[Ajahs]]{{Ref/book|8|26}}.

Although not mentioned directly, Juilane can be assumed to stand for [[Egwene al'Vere]] to be raised [[Amyrlin]].{{Ref/book|12|46}}

She is no longer a Sitter after the reunification as all pre-split Sitters ([[Takima Deraighdin]], [[Janya Frende]], [[Saerin Asnobar]]) retook their former positions and Juilaine was surplus to requirements.{{Ref/book|13|27}}
